description.content: Read custom dashboards and their chart data.
Returns the custom dashboards available to the authenticated workspace. Archived dashboards are excluded.

variable.description: The 'dc' in the API Endpoint URL refers to the MoEngage Data Center (DC). MoEngage hosts each customer in a different DC. You can find your DC number and replace the value of 'dc' in the URL by referring to the DC and API endpoint mapping [here](/api/introduction#data-centers). Your MoEngage Data Center (DC) can be 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, or 101.

Returns the data behind a single chart, as an array of rows. Each call runs the chart's analytics query and returns the result.

query.description: Controls whether the chart data is served from the server-side cache. Set to `false` to bypass the cache and recompute the chart. Defaults to `true`.

info.name: MoEngage Analytics Dashboard and Chart API

description.content: Read-only REST APIs to access your MoEngage Custom Dashboards and the analytics data behind their charts. All endpoints are `GET` requests and do not modify any data.
